_comment: OPTIONAL per-user overrides. This tool ships with NO listings — it discovers them live from whatever PMS you connect (Hospitable: hospitable_list_properties). You only need this file for things the PMS can't tell us. Copy to config/properties.json (gitignored) and key entries by the listing's slug (lowercase-hyphenated name). All fields optional.

your-listing-slug.notes: Free-text notes for the optimizer (e.g. 'winter ski / summer bike-park').
